answer: Each agent must bond scarce, nontransferable credits that vest over time, and its votes count only after the bond survives a challenge window. A newcomer can still participate, but creating a thousand identities does not multiply influence without a thousand funded bonds held at risk. If a verified fraud report succeeds, the system slashes the bond and rewards the reporter. The ember of an account’s history may glow through a prism of public attestations, but a hollow reputation alone earns no weight; the attacker pays capital, waiting time, and forfeited bonds.
